episodes.name: Santabarbaratown 2
episodes.overview: After Henry takes a bullet to the chest and is rushed to the hospital, a spiteful Shawn seeks revenge on the shooter and everyone else involved in the scandal.

episodes.name: Juliet Takes a Luvvah
episodes.overview: Gus gets a girlfriend, and Juliet goes undercover on an online dating site to catch a killer while Shawn tries to holster his jealousy!

episodes.name: Lassie Jerky
episodes.overview: Shawn and Gus join a pair of college students in the woods who are filming a documentary on Bigfoot.

episodes.name: No Country for Two Old Men
episodes.overview: Shawn attempts to bond with Juliet's stepfather Lloyd, a seemingly harmless accountant.

episodes.name: 100 Clues
episodes.overview: On the 100th episode of Psych... Shawn and Gus attend a party hosted by an aging rockstar named Billy Lipps, a man the SBPD arrested years ago for a murder he doesn't remember committing.

episodes.name: Cirque du Soul
episodes.overview: After Gus is tasked with taking care of his girlfriend's son Maximus for the day, he jeopardizes their relationship when an innocent trip to the circus turns deadly.

episodes.name: Deez Nups
episodes.overview: The gang spends the weekend at a casino resort for a wedding and crosses paths with a local crime boss whose presence jeopardizes the impending nuptials.

episodes.name: Right Turn or Left for Dead
episodes.overview: Shawn solves a case involving a mysterious Swedish woman and imagines how the same case would have been solved had he done one thing differently.

episodes.name: Juliet Wears the Pantsuit
episodes.overview: Shawn bonds with Woody, and Juliet befriends a girl who Shawn believes to be a killer.

episodes.name: The Santabarbarian Candidate
episodes.overview: After the Mayor dies in what appears to be a surfing accident, Shawn investigates and ends up running for mayor himself.

episodes.name: Office Space
episodes.overview: After Gus accidentally tampers with the crime where his boss was killed, Shawn helps him find the real murderer before Gus is arrested.

episodes.name: Dead Air
episodes.overview: After Shawn and Gus' favorite radio DJ is murdered, they go undercover as on-air personalities to find his killer.

episodes.name: Nip and Suck It!
episodes.overview: After a woman dies from what appears to be a plastic surgery mishap, Shawn and Gus believe the killer is her doctor, a woman who happens to be an old flame of Henry's.

episodes.name: No Trout About It
episodes.overview: An eccentric police consultant is brought into the SBPD to interview Shawn, Gus, Lassiter and Juliet about their seemingly poor police work on a tough case.

episodes.name: Psych: The Musical
episodes.overview: This musical extravaganza follows Shawn and Gus' search for an escaped playwright who was declared criminally insane following a suspicious fire. Complicating matters, a person who may have important evidence is an enemy from Shawn's past.
